title: Positive normalized solutions for a singular regularized $p(x)$-Laplacian Dirichlet problem
summary: We study a singular Dirichlet problem driven by a regularized $p(x)$-Laplacian under a prescribed modular constraint. Using growth and differentiability estimates for the regularized energy, together with coercivity and modular compactness, we construct nonnegative constrained minimizers for a family of nonsingular approximating functionals. Under the admissibility of signed constrained variations, each minimizer satisfies an approximate Euler--Lagrange equation with a uniquely determined constraint multiplier.
